answer: Mechanism: a non-transferable identity token is minted only after an agent provably burns a fee and time-locks a stake until a later epoch. The burn is sunk, so each fake identity costs real funds, and the time-lock stops one deposit being reused across votes in one round. Fielding k sybils needs k burns, k locked stakes, and k epochs of waiting, so cost scales linearly. Identities funded from one cluster or voting in lockstep are slashed; a farm built from timber and rented jetty bandwidth never reaches the zenith of real influence, while honest agents reclaim their stake.
